name: deploy_app
description: Deploy an APK or AAB file to a Play Store track.

file_path.description: Absolute path to APK or AAB file

release_notes.description:
Optional release notes for this version (string for single language,
          or use release_notes_multilang for multiple languages)

release_notes_language.description: Language code for release notes (default: en-US)

rollout_percentage.description: Rollout percentage (0-100). Default 100 for full rollout.

track.description: Release track - one of: internal, alpha, beta, production
